title: GitHub Actions deploys validated main to production
description:
## Purpose

Deploy the exact validated main revision's static web assets after the required CI checks pass, without a coding agent holding personal AWS credentials.

## Delivered 2026-10-10

- PR #18 promoted main SHA 1fb623a07670357e4e8124b20f6fdab67848ed41.
- GitHub Actions run https://github.com/AnthusAI/Sierrendipity/actions/runs/38065921757 passed specs, runner-linux, typecheck, GitHub OIDC, site publish, CloudFront invalidation, and live provenance verification.
- https://sierrendipity.anth.us/deployment.json serves the same SHA.

## Fulfilled acceptance

- Deployment runs only for trusted pushes to refs/heads/main after specs, runner-linux, and typecheck succeed.
- It deploys the exact event SHA, builds the web asset, stamps provenance, and verifies the uploaded and public revision.
- It uses short-lived GitHub OIDC credentials only; no long-lived AWS credential is stored in GitHub.
- It protects config.json and deployment records from workflow overwrite.

## Scope boundary

This task automates static site content only. It does not invoke CDK and does not deploy backend, runner, or other infrastructure. Those remain human-operated and require separately approved follow-on work.
